name: gitea
summary: Runs the retained local Gitea service outside the cluster for demo source control.

lifecycle.idempotency: Starts or reuses the owned Gitea VM and retained service data.
lifecycle.failure_boundary: Stops before deployment when local virtualization, storage, or the managed SSH identity is unavailable.

readiness: The owned Gitea service is reachable through its managed local address.

security.secret_storage: The service uses the managed encrypted Fleet SSH identity; no password value is stored in this contract.
security.network_trust: Repository access uses the managed local CA and SSH trust controls.
security.external_actions: No remote repository or vendor account is created.
